title: Sandro men’s sale — natural materials only
summary: Audited all 241 products in the requested filtered men’s sale. 61 exact variants pass a strict whole-garment composition gate; 180 contain at least one synthetic or regenerated fiber; 0 were indeterminate. Every visible card links to the exact live Sandro US product page and uses its official selected-color gallery.

recommendation.title: 61 of 241 sale variants passed
recommendation.text: Strict rule: every fiber Sandro lists for the garment must be natural. Polyester, polyamide/nylon, acrylic, elastane, polyurethane, acetate, viscose, lyocell, modal and other manufactured fibers fail. Unspecified hardware and sewing thread remain unknown.
recommendation.test: Sorted by verified sale price, lowest first. Open Sources & evidence on any card for its exact composition, original price, discount, color, product ID, and gallery provenance.

evidenceNote: Each included variant’s exact Sandro US page returned HTTP 200 and listed only natural fibers across every named composition component. The complete audit reconciles 241 unique filtered sale variants: 61 pass, 180 fail, and 0 indeterminate.
caveat: This proves only the composition Sandro publishes. Buttons, zippers, sewing thread, coatings, labels, and other unlisted construction components may still contain manufactured materials.
